name: CROR Training Assistant
statusNote: A content source superseded at parity by Clear Board — its reference entries seeded Clear Board's content library — but kept live on its own page; feature-complete at 305 entries.
oneLiner: A reference-first, citation-backed study PWA for conductors — search any rule, signal, or definition with its citation and trust level, then drill it on a spaced-repetition schedule.
stack: Vanilla JS (ES modules), no build step, no frameworks
Content authored as plain JS data modules so the Node validator and the browser import identical files
PWA: manifest + service worker, offline via stale-while-revalidate

components.name: Schema + validator
components.desc: One entry shape imported by both the app and the Node validator — a hard gate on every entry.

components.name: Content registry
components.desc: 305 entries across definitions, signals, switching, and operating rules, all verbatim rulebook text with citations.

components.name: Search + Reference
components.desc: Keyword and rule-number lookup with list/detail rendering and a visible trust chip.

components.name: Signal renderer
components.desc: The SVG renderer ported from the CN Conductor Trainer.

components.name: Drills
components.desc: Quiz questions derived live from the entries — no parallel question bank to drift.

components.name: Progress + Study
components.desc: Leitner boxes with spaced intervals, an adaptive study dashboard, and a 30-question coverage-balanced mock exam.

components.name: Guide + tour
components.desc: In-app orientation, plus a decorative canvas footer that respects reduced motion.

dataFlow: The app boots to the Reference list; search filters the entries.
Clicking an entry shows its body, citation, trust chip, and related links.
Drills build a question pool from the same entries; each result updates the Leitner box in localStorage.
Study hands its due queue to the same runner; results reschedule due dates.
All state is client-side localStorage — no backend; the service worker serves offline from cache.
integrations: Content re-housed from the CN Conductor Trainer (rule content, citations, signal renderer)
Deliberately distinct from switch-list — the sim and the reference tool link to each other, never duplicate
decisions: Reference-first design: lookup is the front door, drills hang off it.
Content lives in plain JS modules specifically so the validator imports the exact files the app uses — zero divergence.
Never author rule content from memory — every entry requires a reference, source, and trust level, with the chip always visible.
Drills derive from the single content source at runtime instead of a second question bank.
A clean rail-ops theme instead of the house style — this is a field tool for use under pressure.
Offline support was built last, since service workers cache stale copies and mask whether changes work.
